content: mcp-ical PR #20 (verified via gh api): all-day events stored as UTC midnight; in timezones ahead of UTC (e.g. NZDT +13) the local date shows one day early unless timestamps are converted to local time and re-normalized to local midnight/23:59:59. Alarms computed as relativeOffset from the raw (UTC) start inherit the same date shift on recurring all-day events.
